summary: acer nitro 16 gaming laptop experiencing thermal throttling due to PCH overheating, causing system instability and performance issues.
detected_fault: Platform Controller Hub (PCH) temperature consistently above 90°C even at idle, causing CPU frequency to drop and system throttle down.
suggested_solution: Disconnecting the hard drive or solid-state drive, using an older version of Windows 10, or considering Linux as an alternative operating system may help identify and resolve the issue.
